name: Nakazato Hikari
source:
Favorite food: [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tom_yum]Tom yam kung[/url]
Favorite drink: Milk or almost all of carbonated soft drinks

Hikari is [url=/c12955]Kenji[/url] and [url=/c6893]Suzuka[/url]'s older cousin. She is short and has a long, golden-brown hair tied in twin tails. She is somewhat quick-tempered and is a tomboy. Hikari may be annoying but she really cares for her cousins and [url=/c6468]Nanami[/url], and is willing to help them when they're in trouble. She is often pestered by [url=/c12961]Hatano[/url], Kenji's friend and classmate, who is crazy about her every time she visits her cousins during summer. She secretly likes Hatano but is too stubborn to admit it. She loves to eat spicy food.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamune_%28anime%29#Characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
